name: describe_dataset
description: Columns and types of one dataset of the current analysis, and whether the built-in query can read it. Call it before query_dataset when you do not know the column names.

_caller.description: Filled in by the system. Never set it.

_analysis.description: Filled in by the system. Never set it.

name: query_dataset
description: Read-only aggregate query on a dataset of the current analysis. You describe the query; the system builds the SQL. Returns rows plus a result_id that plot_result can draw. To answer for what the user currently sees, add filters for the current control values (see the parameter-driven filters in the analysis summary).

column.description: Column name; may be omitted for count.

agg.description: sum, avg, min, max, count or count_distinct.

grain.description: hour, day, week, month, quarter or year.

op.description: eq, ne, in, not_in, gt, gte, lt, lte, between, contains, is_null, not_null.

value.description: The value for eq, ne, gt, gte, lt, lte, contains. Dates as YYYY-MM-DD.

values.description: The list for in / not_in, or [low, high] for between.

order_by.description: Output column names to sort by.

_caller.description: Filled in by the system. Never set it.

_analysis.description: Filled in by the system. Never set it.

name: distinct_values
description: Up to 50 distinct values of a dataset column (most frequent first), optionally containing a search text. Use it to find the exact value a user means before filtering or suggesting a control value.

search.description: Optional text the value must contain.

_caller.description: Filled in by the system. Never set it.

_analysis.description: Filled in by the system. Never set it.
